text: Why should one person never switch a merchant on alone?
prefix: Why should one person never switch a merchant on alone?

text: Picture one bank admin, rushed or bribed, who switches on a shop nobody else looked at.
prefix: Picture one bank admin, rushed or bribed, who switches on a shop nobody else looked at.

text: By the time anyone notices, that shop has taken a week of payments with stolen cards.

text: Some company cheques need two signatures, so one person alone cannot spend the money.
prefix: Some company cheques need two signatures, so one person alone cannot spend the money.

text: Switching a merchant on works the same way.
prefix: Switching a merchant on works the same way.

text: This is four eyes: two people look at every change that matters.
prefix: This is four eyes: two people look at every change that matters.

text: Here is how it works.
prefix: Here is how it works.

text: There is no button that lets one admin switch a merchant on.
prefix: There is no button that lets one admin switch a merchant on.

text: Instead, one admin, the maker, opens a request.
prefix: Instead, one admin, the maker, opens a request.

text: The maker is the person who asks.
prefix: The maker is the person who asks.

text: Nothing changes yet.
prefix: Nothing changes yet.

text: The merchant stays exactly where it was.
prefix: The merchant stays exactly where it was.

text: A different admin, the checker, decides the request.
prefix: A different admin, the checker, decides the request.

text: The checker is the person who agrees, or refuses.
prefix: The checker is the person who agrees, or refuses.

text: Only when the checker approves does the merchant become active.
prefix: Only when the checker approves does the merchant become active.

text: The maker can never approve their own request.
prefix: The maker can never approve their own request.

text: The screen does not offer it, and the server refuses it anyway, whatever the screen does.
prefix: The screen does not offer it, and the server refuses it anyway, whatever the screen does.

text: A request that nobody decides in time expires.
prefix: A request that nobody decides in time expires.

text: So a forgotten request cannot be approved months later, when nobody remembers why it was opened.
prefix: So a forgotten request cannot be approved months later, when nobody remembers why it was opened.

text: On approval, the documents are checked again, in case something changed meanwhile.
prefix: On approval, the documents are checked again, in case something changed meanwhile.

text: And the history names both people: the checker who approved it, and the maker who asked.
prefix: And the history names both people: the checker who approved it, and the maker who asked.

text: This is not a rule for merchants only.
prefix: This is not a rule for merchants only.

text: It is how the whole product works.
prefix: It is how the whole product works.

text: Anything that moves money or switches something on needs two people.
prefix: Anything that moves money or switches something on needs two people.

text: A new fee rule needs a second admin.
prefix: A new fee rule needs a second admin.

text: So does a longer refund window, and so does a refund that bank staff start.
prefix: So does a longer refund window, and so does a refund that bank staff start.

text: One person proposes; another person decides.
prefix: One person proposes; another person decides.

text: Every one of them uses the same screen, the same grey buttons for the maker, and the same history.

text: The viewer is the first admin, on the approved merchant's page.

text: What does this protect?
prefix: What does this protect?

text: With one person, a single mistake or a single bribe is enough to let a bad shop take money.
prefix: With one person, a single mistake or a single bribe is enough to let a bad shop take money.
